answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 74 identities means 74 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the nebula pair is tracked in the nadir ledger, the juniper audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 21%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
